mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Company Registration of the Taiwan sole shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-strait notarization/verification: Taiwan notary public -> Taiwan Straits Exchange Foundation -> ARATS/provincial Notary Association -> China Notary Association verification -> certified Chinese translation. This is the exclusive parallel path for Taiwan-origin documents; Hague Apostille and consular legalization are not chained or applied.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Recent Company Record of Taiwan shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs online company registration service
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan notarial deed -> Taiwan Straits Exchange Foundation -> mainland Notary Association verification -> certified Chinese translation. Not an Apostille and not a consular legalization; the cross-strait verification path is mandatory and exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney authorizing WFOE incorporation and local representative appointment
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of Taiwan shareholder, notarized by Taiwan notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan notarization -> Taiwan Straits Exchange Foundation -> ARATS/provincial Notary Association -> mainland Notary Association verification. No Apostille or consular legalization step is added; the path is standalone.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association, shareholder resolutions and ownership/UBO statement of Taiwan shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan shareholder as registered with the Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-strait notarization and verification under the 1993 SEF/ARATS Agreement: Taiwan notary -> SEF -> ARATS -> China Notary Association -> certified Chinese translation. Parallel and mutually exclusive with Hague Apostille and consular legalization; never chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter from Taiwan licensed bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing Taiwanese commercial bank (e.g., CTBC Bank, Cathay United Bank or other licensed Taiwanese bank)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For Taiwan-origin version: Taiwan notarization + SEF/ARATS cross-strait verification. If a non-Taiwan branch version is obtained, use that jurisdiction's Hague Apostille only if the jurisdiction is an Apostille member and use consular legalization only if the non-member state requires it; never chain apostille then consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration and Ownership Structure Statement
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan shareholder legal representative and individual ultimate beneficial owner, notarized
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan notarization -> Taiwan Straits Exchange Foundation -> ARATS/provincial Notary Association -> mainland Notary Association verification. This cross-strait mechanism is exclusive for Taiwan-generated documents and is not combined with Hague Apostille or consular legalization.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All shareholders, UBOs, directors, legal representatives, authorized signatories and beneficial owners of the Taiwan investor must be screened at onboarding and continuously against the PRC terrorist financing and money-laundering blacklists, Ministry of Public Security terrorist list, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions, OFAC SDN list, EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions, and applicable PBOC/SAMR watchlists. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons, their family members and close associates. EDD includes source of wealth and source of funds verification, senior management approval, enhanced transaction monitoring of Amazon Pay, Stripe and Airwallex settlement accounts, and suspicious transaction reporting to the China Financial Intelligence Center without undue delay. Records must be retained for at least five years after relationship termination.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR National Enterprise Name Registration and Pre-approval Online System (National Market Entity Registration Service Platform)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: WFOE names must follow the mandatory four-tier structure: [Administrative Division] + [Distinctive Trade Name] + [Industry or Business Characteristics] + [Company Form]. The legal name must be in simplified Chinese characters; pinyin and English translations are supplementary and do not control. For a Taiwanese-invested WFOE, the Chinese trade name may be a phonetic or semantic transliteration of the Taiwan shareholder name, provided it is not identical to a preexisting registered name and does not imply state affiliation. Foreign-language names may be used commercially but are not the registered Chinese legal name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant must retrieve the written rejection reason from the SAMR portal, correct the deficient name tokens or corporate structure, and resubmit a fresh name application through the same online channel. If the applicant disputes the rejection, it may file an administrative reconsideration application within 60 days to the SAMR authority at the next higher level or to the same-level people's government, and thereafter file an administrative lawsuit within 6 months at the competent people's court. The appeal must attach the original application record, rejection notice, corrective corporate documents, a legal opinion on compliance with naming rules, and at least three revised name alternatives. The original administrative refusal remains binding during the appeal period.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office and commercial mailbox arrangements are not permissible as the registered office for a PRC WFOE. SAMR requires a fixed physical address evidenced by a lease agreement and property ownership certificate or a building with a formal street number. Tax authorities will reject a virtual mailbox for VAT invoice issuance and for matching the WFOE's tax registration address. Banks will also reject a virtual office for RMB and foreign-currency settlement account opening. A licensed co-working or serviced-office space may be acceptable if the lessor permits company registration and tax inspection access; a pure commercial-mailbox service cannot satisfy the statutory substance test. For an Amazon FBA WFOE, the registered office must also be consistent with customs/export records and any VAT invoice address to avoid administrative penalties.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: company nameplate on site; presence of staff or designated personnel; valid lease invoice and utility bills matching the registered address; labor contracts and social insurance declarations; business records and vouchers accessible; evidence of e-commerce operational substance; consistency between declared turnover and office/warehouse capacity. Quantified risk: moderate, approximately 20-30% likelihood of an unannounced municipal tax or SAMR physical inspection within the first 12 months for a newly registered WFOE in a Tier-2 city; the probability rises to 50-60% if the tax filing address is a co-working space, there are inconsistencies with Amazon FBA inventories, VAT refund applications are made, or the declared income is disproportionately high relative to the physical site.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 2018 (Taiwan), as amended; specifically Articles 128-156 (incorporation and share capital), Articles 192-206 (directors and board of directors), Article 208 (representative director), and Article 369-1 et seq. (affiliated enterprises).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Taiwan Company Registration Bureau, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), with parallel municipal filing at the Taipei City Government Department of Economic Development.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (公司章程) together with the Company Registration Application Form (公司登記申請書) filed through the MOEA Company Registration Online System.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital for a WFOE limited liability company under the Companies Act; however, the capital amount stated in the Articles of Incorporation must be reasonable and proportionate to the registered business scope. The Ministry of Economic Affairs recommends that the initial paid-in capital be deposited in a dedicated escrow account in the company's name at a Taiwan bank (or a foreign branch approved by the FSC) and evidenced by a Capital Verification Certificate (資本額查核報告書) issued by a licensed CPA before registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION OF THE FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY NAME], a Taiwan Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise Limited Liability Company, duly convened at the registered office in Taipei, Taiwan (R.O.C.), at [time] on [date], with notice duly waived by all directors pursuant to Article 204 of the Taiwan Companies Act.

WHEREAS: (1) The company was incorporated under the laws of Taiwan with the approval of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, and its Articles of Incorporation authorize a board of not less than one director; (2) The shareholders, being the sole foreign corporate shareholder, have lawfully appointed the undersigned directors and confirmed the initial paid-in capital subscription in accordance with the Articles; (3) The board is now required to adopt the foundational corporate governance and administrative resolutions necessary for the company to lawfully commence business, open bank accounts, adopt a registered office, issue share certificates, and proceed with all requisite industrial and commercial licensing.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, by unanimous consent of the board of directors, as follows:

1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION AND ALLOTMENT: That the proposed subscription of the authorized share capital, being New Taiwan Dollars [amount] divided into [number] ordinary shares with par value of NT$[par value] each, is hereby ratified and confirmed. The board authorizes the chairperson or any vice chairperson to execute a share subscription statement on behalf of each subscriber, to collect and deposit the corresponding subscription monies into the company's capital escrow account, to issue fully paid-up share certificates bearing the corporate seal, and to register the allotment in the shareholders' register. The board confirms that no subscription money has been withdrawn and that the minimum regulatory endorsement of the CPA has been obtained.

2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION: That the chairperson, managing director, or any director designated by the chairperson, together with the company secretary or the chief financial officer, shall be and they are hereby jointly and severally authorized to open, operate, maintain, and close bank accounts in the name of the company at any commercial bank lawfully operating in Taiwan, including but not limited to foreign-currency, multi-currency, and cross-border settlement accounts, and to execute all account mandates, signature cards, electronic banking agreements, and transactional instructions. Any two designated signatories shall be required for all drawings, indemnities, and contractual undertakings in excess of NT$[threshold]; any one such signatory may act for amounts at or below that threshold.

3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION: That the registered office of the company shall be and is hereby fixed at [full address], Taipei, Taiwan, and the board authorizes the chairperson to execute a lease or service agreement, to pay all incidental fees, and to notify the Company Registration Bureau and the competent tax authority of the adoption and any subsequent change of registered office in accordance with law.

4. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS: That [name] is hereby appointed as Chairperson and Representative Director, [name] is appointed as Managing Director (if applicable), [name] is appointed as Company Secretary, and [name] is appointed as Chief Financial Officer. Each appointee accepts office and shall ensure compliance with all statutory duties, including the preparation of financial statements within the time prescribed by Article 228 of the Taiwan Companies Act, preservation of corporate records, and immediate filing of the registration of the representative director with the Ministry of Economic Affairs.

5. INCIDENTAL AUTHORIZATIONS: That the chairperson and company secretary, acting jointly, are authorized to affix the company seal, to authenticate all documents, to engage attorneys, accountants, and notaries, and to take every action necessary to effectuate the foregoing resolutions, including the application for tax registration, VAT registration, customs registry, foreign-investment approval filing, and any operating licenses required for the company's business.

This Resolution shall be effective immediately upon adoption and shall remain in full force until revoked or amended by a subsequent resolution of the board. All actions taken by the officers in reliance on this Resolution before its revocation are hereby ratified and confirmed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Pre-Approval and Foreign Investment Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) Department of Commerce - Company Name Pre-Approval Online System; Investment Commission (InvesTaiwan) for foreign investment screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign parent company must first submit the proposed English and Chinese company name for pre-approval via the MOEA Company Registration Online System, paying the administrative fee and securing a reserved name certificate valid for six months. In parallel, the non-resident investor must file an Application for Foreign Investment Approval with the Investment Commission, disclosing the ultimate beneficial owner, source of funds, and proposed business scope. The business scope must confirm that internet-based retail sale via Amazon FBA marketplace is not a negative-list restricted activity; if the Commission issues a query, the investor shall submit a curative explanation and a power-of-attorney authentication document within the official response window. Only after both approvals are received may the share capital deposit and registration application proceed.
required_dossiers: Completed company name reservation application with two alternative names
Foreign Investment Approval Application Form
Certified copy of foreign parent company incorporation certificate or equivalent
Passport or corporate ID of ultimate beneficial owner (apostilled/legalized)
Power of attorney to the local filing agent, notarized in the home jurisdiction
Proposed business scope statement referencing ISIC 4791 / NAICS 454110
Bank reference letter evidencing source of funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, immediately file an administrative appeal with the MOEA Department of Commerce, or submit a revised name preselection. If the foreign investment application is queried, provide supplemental UBO declarations, source-of-funds evidence, and a revised parent-company affidavit; where a formal denial is issued, the investor may file a written objection to the Executive Yuan within thirty days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Escrow Deposit and CPA Capital Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A licensed Taiwan CPA registered with the National Federation of Certified Public Accountants; capital-verification reporting follows MOEA standards
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After foreign investment approval, the sole shareholder must remit the subscribed capital, denominated in New Taiwan Dollars or an approved foreign currency converted into NT$, into a newly opened capital escrow account bearing the company's provisional corporate ID and exact future name. The remitting bank must issue a deposit balance certificate stating the account holder, date, and balance. The appointed Taiwan CPA then performs independent verification of the subscribed capital, confirms that no funds have been withdrawn and that no loans or deposits have been substituted for actual capitalization, and issues a Capital Verification Report. This report is an unconditional prerequisite to the company registration filing. If the report reveals a capital shortfall, the shareholder must wire the missing funds and restart the three-business-day bank confirmation cycle before the CPA reissues the certificate.
required_dossiers: Foreign investment approval certificate issued by the Investment Commission
Company name pre-approval certificate
Draft Articles of Incorporation and subscriber sheet
Bank deposit balance certificate for the escrow account
CPA engagement letter and capital verification report
Notarized power of attorney for the local representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CPA declines to issue a clean verification due to mixed or inadequately sourced funds, the company shall segregate funds into a dedicated capital subscription account, obtain a fresh bank certificate, and submit a sworn statement from the subscriber confirming the lawful origin of the funds. If the bank suspends the account for AML review, provide the SWIFT remittance record and foreign investment approval to the bank compliance officer and escalate to the FSC Banking Bureau for clearance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Registration Filing at MOEA and Corporate Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Department of Commerce - Company Registration Section; municipal registration office at the Taipei City Government
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The local filing agent must electronically submit the Company Registration Application through the MOEA Company Registration Online System, attaching the notarized Articles of Incorporation, the Capital Verification Report, the name reservation certificate, and the foreign investment approval. The system calculates the statutory registration fee; the filing is deemed incomplete if the supporting documents are scanned in color below 300 DPI or if the paid-in capital table fails to reconcile with the CPA report. MOEA examiners review for formal compliance under Articles 388 and 400 of the Companies Act, after which the registry issues the Company Registration Certificate (公司登記證明書) and assigns a unified business number. The entity must be registered within six months of the name reservation; otherwise, the name is released and step one must be repeated.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Application Form signed by the representative director
Articles of Incorporation duly notarized
CPA Capital Verification Report
Name pre-approval certificate
Foreign Investment Approval Certificate
Lease agreement or registered-office service contract
Consent forms of all directors and supervisors
Identification documents of all directors and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOEA issues a suspension or clarification notice, the company must respond through the online portal within fourteen days with a corrected application and a cover letter explaining each discrepancy; if deficiencies remain uncured, the company may request an administrative reconsideration before the MOEA Appeal Committee. Where the name has been released due to delay, the company must immediately reserve a successor name and refile, while the foreign investment approval remains valid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting, Tax Registration, and Post-Registration Licenses
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors; National Taxation Administration (Ministry of Finance), Taipei National Tax Administration; local municipal business registration; Central Bank of China for foreign-exchange filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon issuance of the Company Registration Certificate, the directors must hold the First Board Meeting to adopt the pro-forma resolution covering share certificates, banking mandates, corporate seal custody, and officer appointments. Immediately thereafter, the company must apply for the Unified Business Number Incorporation Tax Registration with the Taipei National Tax Administration; with effect from the date of corporate registration, the company will be registered for profit-enterprise income tax and value-added tax. The company must apply for the permit to use uniform invoices and, because the activity is cross-border e-commerce on Amazon FBA, register with the customs authorities for export/import registry if goods transit Taiwan. A corporate foreign-currency account must be opened at a Taiwan bank and the Central Bank of China notified of incoming foreign direct investment. For pure digital retailer operations with no Taiwan physical inventory, no factory operating license or EIA permit is required; if the company later operates an Amazon FBA warehouse or assembly facility in Taiwan, it must obtain the relevant municipal business registration, fire safety certification, and environmental permits before commencement.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Certificate and unified business number
Minutes of the First Board of Directors meeting and Resolution
Corporate seal impression card and bank signature cards
Foreign Investment Approval and QB/Business registration numbers
Office lease or service address proof
Articles of Incorporation and shareholder registers
Uniform invoice application form (with retention/sales invoice registration)
Currency declaration forms for capital inflow to the Central Bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Taipei National Taxation Administration issues a punitive registration penalty for late filing, file an application for abatement with supporting proof of MOEA approval delay. If the customs export registration is rejected because Amazon FBA is deemed an overseas warehouse service, submit the ECMS customs declaration manual and a service agreement with Amazon to reclassify the activity as export sales. If the bank refuses account opening pending enhanced due diligence, provide the Investment Commission approval and tax registration to the bank's AML committee; if still refused, engage a different licensed bank and notify the Central Bank.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - the registered ISIC 4791 (Retail Sale via Internet) and NAICS 454110 (Electronic Shopping and Mail-Order Houses) is a pure digital marketplace retail classification with no physical manufacturing, chemical processing, assembly, or warehousing performed in Taiwan.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - no factory, industrial plant, or physical warehouse operation is established under the current business scope. The company shall operate as an Amazon FBA cross-border e-commerce entity, and any ancillary IP licensing or consulting requires no industrial operating license.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable - no physical project triggering EIA obligations under the EIA Act (Environmental Impact Assessment Act, R.O.C.); if future warehousing is established, jurisdiction would belong to the Environmental Protection Administration (EPA) and relevant Bureau of Environmental Protection of the Taiwan municipal government.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Not Applicable for pure digital retail and marketplace intermediary activity. A full Environmental Impact Assessment would be required only if the company subsequently constructs or operates an industrial storage facility exceeding 1,200 square meters or engages in any designated development activity under Annex I of the EIA Act.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - no wastewater discharge, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste handling is associated with the current pure digital commerce operation. In any future limited warehousing scenario, the operator must observe the Sedimentation Tank Effluent Standards (COD below 100 mg/L, SS below 30 mg/L for discharged effluents into public sewers), Taiwan Emission Standards for Volatile Organic Compounds in the semiconductor and general industrial sectors where applicable, and the Waste Disposal Act registration for any hazardous waste stream above statutory thresholds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable - no physical workplace, factory, or public-facing warehouse operations exist, and therefore no Civil Defense fire safety protection certificate, structural load inspection, or occupational safety facility inspection is triggered. A general office lease is subject to standard building fire safety compliance and the landlord must hold a valid fire safety certificate for the shared building; if home-office or co-working premises are utilized, the operator shall confirm compliance with the Building Public Safety Inspection Regulations. Should the company decide in future to operate an Amazon FBA binding/returns processing center in Taiwan, the operator must obtain a Fire Safety Management Plan approved by the local fire department, a Certificate of Fire Safety Equipment Installation, a building structural safety assessment, and a Labor Safety and Health Certificate under the Occupational Safety and Health Act before the workplace opens.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance, Taxation Administration (Taiwan), with operational collection by the Regional National Taxation Bureaus; electronic portal: https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: The foreign non-resident corporate shareholder of the WFOE must obtain foreign investment approval from the Investment Commission of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), submitting certified constitutional documents, board resolution, and investment plan. Step 2: After approval, file company registration with the MOEA Company and Commerce One-Stop Registration Service using the registered Taiwan address, capital schedule, and statutory responsible-person details; this creates the Taiwanese limited company and generates a unified business number (UBIN/TIN). Step 3: Register the newly formed WFOE for business tax (VAT) with the local National Taxation Bureau and complete the taxpayer-account profile, including line-of-business and invoice usage, and appoint a Taiwan fiscal representative for service of tax documents. Step 4: Activate the MOF e-Tax Portal credentials and, for electronic-invoice issuance, apply for the Ministry of Finance Integrated Electronic Invoice Cloud Platform certificate. Step 5: Maintain statutory registration updates within 15 days of any name, address, responsible person, business scope, or capital change.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: TWD 200,000 in average monthly taxable sales; mandatory VAT registration is triggered above this threshold, while smaller merchants may qualify as small-scale enterprises applying special simplified business-tax treatment
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT-registered businesses must issue Uniform Invoices for every taxable sale. Businesses designated as electronic-invoice merchants must transmit each electronic Uniform Invoice to the MOF Integrated Electronic Invoice Cloud Platform (Turnkey Server) through official APIs or batch channels, attaching the platform-generated QR code and random anti-fraud invoice number. This cloud transmission constitutes the statutory real-time fiscal clearance/anti-fraud stamping obligation for both B2B and B2C transactions; non-transmission or material inaccuracies are treated in audit as issuance of a false or missing Uniform Invoice, subject to the same penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically exported from Taiwan to a foreign destination (including offshore Amazon FBA fulfillment centers) qualify for the 0% export VAT rate if the Taiwanese exporter contracts with a foreign buyer or authorized representative and ultimately proves actual shipment outside the local customs territory. Qualifying zero-rated categories also include services rendered to foreign enterprises in connection with exported goods and qualifying offshore digital services, provided the consideration is paid in foreign currency and no economic use of the service occurs in Taiwan.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Entry / Bill of Entry) filed electronically with Taiwan Customs
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure of goods from Taiwan
Commercial invoice and packing list issued by the exporting WFOE
Purchase order, contract, or written agreement evidencing the cross-border sale
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or bank foreign-currency receipt evidencing payment repatriation by the offshore buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The National Taxation Bureau may retroactively review the zero-rated export claims by demand-file audit. Taxpayers must maintain a seamless chain from export declaration, transportation documents, custody records at the overseas FBA warehouse, and foreign exchange receipt showing collection of export proceeds in foreign currency. If the foreign-exchange proceeds are not repatriated to Taiwan within 180 days of the export date (or approved extension) or if any export document is false, fabrication of export status, or otherwise unverifiable, the zero rating is disallowed and the tax authority will reassess 5% business tax on the sales consideration with statutory late-payment interest, apply the understatement/short-payment penalty under the Business Tax Act (up to roughly two and a half times the tax evaded for intentional fraud, with criminal liability for document forgery), and issue a demand order; persistent violations may additionally suspend the e-invoice credential and confiscate the evaded tax.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) / State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) of the People's Republic of China
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMB is freely convertible on the current account, encompassing cross-border trade in goods and services and therefore all Amazon FBA-related export proceeds may be settled through designated banks. The capital account, including FDI equity injections from the Taiwanese parent, remains subject to SAFE registration and quota controls. The WFOE must open a capital foreign exchange settlement account upon receipt of the inbound remittance, verify the funds with a certified public accountant, and convert RMB only for purposes within the registered business scope. Profit repatriation to the Taiwanese shareholder is permissible only after independent annual audit certification, payment of corporate income tax and distribution under the 10% withholding tax (or treaty-protected rate), plus production of a board resolution and evidence of natural-person ultimate beneficial ownership. No mandatory surrender of export proceeds currently exists, but all goods-trade receipts must be repatriated within 180 days of customs declaration and reported under the SAFE monitoring system. Dividend outbound transfers require a second foreign exchange account and must be executed through the bank's FX settlement price. Compliance with the People's Bank of China's anti-money laundering rules and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange's digital trading platform (ASOne) is mandatory before any cross-border conversion is approved.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Goods-trade export proceeds from the Amazon FBA operation must be repatriated to China through the settlement bank within 180 days of the date of departure of the shipment from the Chinese customs warehouse. The statutory mandatory conversion ratio is currently zero percent, but the WFOE must present the signed export verification form, logistics proof and customs declarations in the SAFE system. Retained foreign exchange is permitted within the approved annual credit ceiling, and any conversion from USD to RMB is purely at the enterprise's commercial election at the prevailing market rate.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Limited

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Goods Trade Foreign Exchange Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore fintech EMIs such as Airwallex and Stripe are not licensed as banks in mainland China and are legally barred from maintaining the WFOE's capital account, receiving FDI injections, or providing direct FX conversion services on behalf of the WFOE. They may only serve as third-party payment processors for low-value e-commerce sales through a licensed Chinese partner bank, and all funds must ultimately settle into a domestic corporate bank account. For the required capital verification, profit remittance and trade-based FX hedging, a Tier-1 domestic commercial bank remains mandatory. The use of Airwallex or Stripe as an inbound channel for the Taiwanese parent's investment would constitute an unauthorized cross-border payment scheme and trigger immediate SAFE enforcement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The statutory legal representative of the WFOE is required to appear physically at the bank branch for the initial account opening interview and signature specimen card, together with one officer of the board of directors. For overseas-based legal representatives, a remotely notarized power of attorney appointing a resident director in China is acceptable for basic RMB accounts, but the capital foreign exchange settlement account requires a physical visit to the bank's designated foreign business department in the city of registration. China does not permit a consular proxy opening without a local attorney and the original power of attorney endorsed by the Chinese embassy; remote video identity verification is accepted only by a minority of banks for non-FDI operational accounts and must be supplemented by a China-verified legal representative identity certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multi-layer offshore ownership chain from Taiwan to the Chinese WFOE via intermediate Hong Kong SPVs, creating an opaque beneficial ownership structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified incorporation extracts of all intermediate companies; audited financial statements of the Taiwanese parent for the past three years; a fully executed group organization chart showing each natural-person shareholder; notarized natural-person UBO declarations; and evidence of commercial substance including office leases, employee lists and payroll records for each SPV.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection amount disproportionately high relative to the Amazon FBA sales scale, suggesting possible round-tripping or money-laundering via FDI.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Formal board resolution from the Taiwanese parent approving the injection; three-month source-of-wealth evidence including parent bank reference letters and corporate tax filings; a detailed 12-month business plan with working capital forecast and fixed-asset budget; the latest Amazon seller central statements and order volumes; and pro-forma supplier invoices from Chinese factories substantiating the funding requirement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity, low-ticket sales receipts from third-party marketplace platforms (Amazon, Stripe, Airwallex) creating an unstructured layering trail that obscures trade genuineness.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed platform services agreements; historic settlement reports from Amazon, Stripe and Airwallex for a continuous 12-month period; customs export declarations (Customs Declaration Form 8800) matched to each batch by airway bill or bill of lading; payment transfer vouchers from the payment processors to the WFOE's bank account; and supplier logistics receipts demonstrating real goods movement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and trade-based money laundering exposure from selling to sensitive jurisdictions through Amazon's global marketplace.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A formal sanctions compliance policy covering OFAC, EU, UK and UN restricted parties; Amazon Seller Central geo-blocking proof confirming excluded countries; the WFOE's active product typology and export HS codes; a certified end-use statement that no controlled goods or dual-use items are sold; and certificates of origin for the physical inventory held in FBA warehouses.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The inbound capital injection must be routed via SWIFT MT103 from the Taiwanese parent's bank to the WFOE's FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Settlement Account at the designated Tier-1 bank in China. The remittance shall carry the explicit purpose code 1101 'return of investment' or 7210 'foreign direct investment' and include in field 70 the SAFE filing registration number and the chart of the capital verification account. Upon receipt, the WFOE must submit the capital verification report prepared by a certified public accountant, then complete the capital account reconciliation and RMB settlement in SAFE's ASOne system. The converted RMB balance can then be transferred to the basic deposit account for operating liquidity. A second SAFE registration is required for any subsequent increase in paid-in capital.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements can be settled via SWIFT MT103 for open-account supplier payments above USD 5,000, using purpose codes 1210 (export trade settlement) or 1220 (import trade settlement) after submission of the underwriting contract and invoice. For large consolidated factory purchases, a Documentary Collection (D/P or D/A) through a Chinese negotiating bank is preferred, while a Commercial Letter of Credit may be issued against the WFOE's available credit line for high-value raw material imports. All disbursements to Amazon's logistics service providers and FBA warehouses must be supported by invoice, packing list and freight forwarder receipt for matching by the bank's compliance desk.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore foreign exchange forward contracts with maturity up to 12 months, requiring a verified current-account trade exposure
Foreign exchange currency swaps (RMB/USD) executed with a licensed Chinese bank for hedged cash-flow conversions
FX option contracts, specifically plain-vanilla European options for USD/RMB, on a removal-of-real-trade-background basis

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are NOT permissible for the onshore WFOE; any NDF hedging must occur on the books of the Taiwanese parent or a non-resident affiliate operating outside SAFE's jurisdiction

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary shareholders meeting and statutory financial statement presentation; for a single-shareholder WFOE, a written sole-shareholder resolution may replace the physical meeting but must be recorded
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company and Commercial Registration Agency (inspection/registry authority; no annual filing fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 30 June following a calendar-year fiscal close; filing anniversary is six months after the balance-sheet date for non-calendar-year companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of NTD 10,000 to NTD 50,000 per responsible person; absence of ordinary business or cessation for more than six months gives the MOEA authority to issue an administrative dissolution/strike-off order under Company Act Article 10.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual profit-seeking enterprise income tax return, tax finalization, and related certified financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year taxpayer, filing and payment are due by 31 May of the following year; extended due date may apply when the statutory date falls on a weekend or official holiday
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest is calculated on unpaid tax (currently approximately 1% per 30 days under the Tax Collection Act); failure to file permits tax authority estimated assessment plus delinquency penalties under Income Tax Act Articles 108/110, including fines up to three times the underpaid tax; persistent non-compliance can cause tax registration cancellation and administrative strike-off of the company registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual operational report/implementation statement for the foreign investment approval applicable to the WFOE ownership chain
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the end of the fiscal year, ordinarily no later than 30 June in the following year for calendar-year investors; anniversary-based where an investment approval letter imposes a different reporting interval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Warning and administrative fine under investment regulations; repeated or intentional non-filing may result in suspension or revocation of the foreign investment approval, which in turn exposes the WFOE to de-registration/strike-off by MOEA.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Substantial controller/actual beneficial owner registration and update in the MOEA company registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, MOEA Company Registration Portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 calendar days after any shareholding transfer, ownership structure change, director change, or other change in substantial controllers; no separate annual confirmation filing is required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Company Act Article 22-1 imposes a fine of NTD 10,000 to NTD 50,000 per responsible person for each non-compliant filing; continuing default can be penalized repeatedly and treated as failure to maintain lawful statutory records, supporting an administrative strike-off action.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent certified CPA audit/attestation is mandatory in Taiwan when: (i) paid-in capital is NTD 30 million or more; (ii) the enterprise is a public issuer, TWSE/TPEx listed company, or FSC-regulated securities firm; (iii) the WFOE has annual net revenue equal to or exceeding NTD 30 million; (iv) balance-sheet total assets equal or exceed NTD 30 million; or (v) the enterprise employs on average more than 100 employees and is designated by the competent authority. ISIC 4791 Amazon FBA operations are cross-border e-commerce, so these revenue/asset triggers are measured on Taiwan-source and world-wide sales net of returns, as reflected in the auditable general ledger and annual financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: FSC-endorsed TIFRS (Taiwan-International Financial Reporting Standards, IFRS as adopted) governs public issuers and large mandated enterprises; non-public SMEs may apply Taiwan SME GAAP/Business Entity Accounting Standards together with the Commercial Accounting Act and Company Act. Any statutory CPA audit must be performed by a ROC-licensed certified public accountant under the applicable Statements on Auditing Standards.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Taiwan does not require an annual UBO confirmation return. Instead, the WFOE must maintain a current register of substantial controllers and file changes with MOEA within a strict 15-day event-driven reporting window following share transfers, director changes, or control changes. The annual compliance check therefore consists of reconciling shareholding movements and substantial-controller data at each year-end and verifying that every qualifying transfer during the year was reported within the 15-day deadline and not merely at annual confirmation.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 to USD 900 per year for registered office and corporate secretarial agent services in Taiwan
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 to USD 15,000 for a full certified CPA audit of a cross-border e-commerce WFOE with Amazon FBA turnover; a compilation/review-only mandate may cost USD 1,500 to USD 3,000 when the WFOE is below the statutory audit thresholds

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday for WFOE e-commerce operations. Preferential incentives are limited to approved categories such as qualified R&D investment tax credits, smart machinery/5G equipment credits, and other government-promoted strategic industries. Amazon FBA marketplace resale does not qualify as a statutory tax holiday activity. Effective rate may be reduced by verified loss carryforwards.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 20 - Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Settlement Return (營利事業所得稅結算申報書); filed electronically via the Ministry of Finance E-Tax Filing Portal (電子申報繳稅服務網, tax.nat.gov.tw)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 5 months after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year WFOE, due on 31 May.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form 20, Section A, Box 01 - Gross Operating Revenue (營業收入總額)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report all gross Amazon FBA / marketplace sales including product revenue, buyer-paid shipping, and platform fees charged to the seller, before deduction of FBA fulfillment, advertising, and referral commissions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Taiwan-resident WFOE must report worldwide trade income in this line. A non-resident seller without Taiwan registration should not use this line for net remittance; separate withholding or branch filing rules apply.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form 20, Line 05 - Operating Costs (營業成本)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter cost of goods sold, including inventory purchased from the PRC parent or suppliers, freight, customs duties, and Amazon FBA fulfillment costs directly allocable to cost of sales.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Related-party purchases must be priced at arm's length and supported by invoices and import documentation; non-resident branches must apportion Taiwan-source costs on traceable, substantiated bases.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form 20, Line 22 - Operating Expenses (營業費用)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating expenses such as Amazon referral fees, FBA storage/returns, advertising, Stripe/Airwallex payment processing fees, rent, salaries, professional fees, and transfer pricing documentation costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fees paid to non-residents are deductible only if withholding tax has been duly declared and paid; payments to offshore affiliates must be supported by transactional economic substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form 20, Line 53 - Prior-Year Loss Deduction (虧損扣除)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Carry forward verified audited losses from the preceding 10 years under Article 39 of the Income Tax Act; the loss-year return must have been examined or recognized by the tax authority.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Taiwan branch of a non-resident enterprise may carry forward Taiwan-source losses only on the same statutory conditions and subject to the same administrative verification process.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a surcharge of 1% of the unpaid tax for each two-day delay, up to 15%; penalties may be imposed up to 3 times the underpaid tax; enforced collection includes liens, asset freezes, and travel bans under the Tax Collection Act.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Provisional Return (營利事業所得稅暫繳申報書); filed through the same Ministry of Finance E-Tax Portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due by 30 September for the first half-year period; the final settlement reconciles provisional tax paid against annual tax liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Provisional Return, Box A - Estimated First-Half Taxable Income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimate the first six months' taxable income and calculate provisional tax at 20%; the taxpayer may pay 50% of estimated annual tax or use the first-half profit method.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident branch must use the same provisional filing obligation only if it has a fixed place of business and derives Taiwan-source income; otherwise final withholding rules apply.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Provisional Return, Box B - Prior Withholding Credits (可抵繳暫繳稅款)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter withholding tax credits and other prepayments that may offset the provisional tax amount.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident taxpayers claiming treaty or reduced withholding must attach approvals; credits are allowed only for verified Taiwan-source withheld amounts.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to pay provisional tax results in a 1% surcharge per two-day delay up to 15%, plus interest, and the outstanding amount may be enforced through collection proceedings.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 21% on dividends distributed by a Taiwan WFOE to a non-resident shareholder; no treaty reduction is available for a PRC parent because the Cross-Strait Taxation Agreement is not in force.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: For jurisdictions covered by an effective Taiwan DTA, the non-resident beneficial owner must obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from its home tax authority and submit it, together with a treaty relief application, to the Taiwan distribution/withholding agent before payment; the National Taxation Bureau may issue reduced-rate approval or permit a refund after review. Reduced dividend rates typically require at least 25% direct shareholding and genuine economic substance. PRC residents currently cannot invoke treaty relief due to lack of an in-force cross-strait agreement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid to non-residents are subject to statutory withholding of 20%, with DTA rates commonly reduced to approximately 10%; interest paid to non-residents is subject to statutory withholding of 20%, with DTA rates commonly reduced to approximately 10-15%. Payments characterized as service fees may be recharacterized as royalties if the substance is IP exploitation.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File / Transfer Pricing Report: mandatory when annual related-party transaction amounts reach NT$200 million or more; Master File and Country-by-Country Report: mandatory when the multinational group's consolidated revenue reaches NT$27 billion or more.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Taiwan has not enacted a Caribbean-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) regime, but the tax authority applies substance-over-form, general anti-abuse rules, and profit recharacterization principles. A Taiwan WFOE engaged in Amazon FBA must maintain real office premises, local employees, records and decision-making functions; lack of economic substance may result in disallowance of deductions, transfer pricing recharacterization, or application of CFC/imputation rules.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting Amazon FBA gross revenue, diverting marketplace proceeds through Stripe, Airwallex or personal bank accounts, fabricating Chinese supplier invoices, or inflating fake operating costs.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authority may assess taxable income under the deemed or highest-profit method; underpaid tax incurs a surcharge of 1% per two-day delay up to 15%, plus a penalty up to 3 times the underpaid tax; criminal tax evasion can lead to imprisonment of up to 5 years and monetary fines under the Tax Collection Act and related criminal provisions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or knowingly cause false returns are subject to criminal prosecution, personal fines, travel bans, and asset freezing; courts may pierce the corporate veil where the WFOE is used as a sham for tax fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying excessive royalties, management fees, or inflated intercompany purchase prices to a PRC parent or offshore shell with no employees, premises, or economic substance; failing to file mandatory Transfer Pricing Report when thresholds are met.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Taiwan tax authorities may adjust related-party transactions to arm's length, impute additional taxable income, impose interest and late penalties up to 3 times the underpaid tax, and disallow related deductions; unresolved transfer pricing audits may lead to criminal tax evasion referrals in egregious cases.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: CFOs, tax directors, and approving directors may be jointly liable if they knowingly executed non-arm's-length transactions; travel restrictions and civil restitution may be ordered where corporate assets are stripped.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding Tax Non-Compliance on Profit Repatriation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Remitting dividends to the PRC or other non-resident parent without withholding 21% dividend tax; paying royalties or interest to offshore affiliates without statutory 20% withholding; mischaracterizing dividends as loans, service fees, or repayments of shareholder loans.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Taiwan withholding agent is personally liable for the uncollected tax; penalties may range from one to three times the under-withheld amount, plus daily surcharges, interest, enforced collection, and potential criminal liability if intentional.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and payment officers who authorize unlawful remittances can be compelled to pay the withheld tax personally; in serious cases, travel bans and enforcement orders will prevent exit from Taiwan.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using Amazon FBA payment chains to launder proceeds, structuring cashouts through multiple payment platforms, nominee bank accounts, or failing to disclose beneficial owners and transaction patterns required by Taiwan AML rules.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violations of the Taiwan Money Laundering Control Act may result in imprisonment of up to 7 years and substantial fines; administrative penalties, asset forfeiture, and account seizure may also be imposed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face personal criminal exposure for willful blindness or deliberate circumvention of AML controls; travel bans and cross-border mutual legal assistance may be invoked by authorities.
